Capabilities

What ClearGlass works on

Four connected service areas. Each one starts from the systems and data an organization already runs.

Software & Systems Architecture

System design for software that has to stay understandable as it grows: service boundaries, data flows, integration points, and the documentation that keeps them maintainable.

  • Architecture reviews and target-state designs
  • Integration and data-flow mapping
  • Technical documentation and decision records

AI Automation & Integration

Automation that fits into existing work, with defined inputs, human approval where decisions carry risk, and a record of what each automated step did.

  • Workflow automation design
  • Model and tool integration
  • Human approval points for higher-risk steps

Cybersecurity & Digital Risk

Security work scoped to the systems and data an organization actually runs: understanding exposure, prioritizing fixes, and planning for incidents.

  • Risk and exposure assessments
  • Hardening and configuration review
  • Incident-readiness planning

Governance & Technical Operations

Operating controls for technology teams: who can approve what, how changes are recorded, and how systems are looked after once they are live.

  • Approval and change-control design
  • Audit trails and operational records
  • Runbooks and maintenance routines

Approach

How an engagement runs

A proposed engagement process. Each phase ends with something you can review before the next one begins.

  1. 01

    Discover

    Understand the current systems, constraints, data and decision-makers before proposing anything.

    OutputA written summary of scope, constraints and open questions.

  2. 02

    Architect

    Design the target state and the path to it, with trade-offs and risks stated plainly.

    OutputAn architecture and delivery plan for your review and approval.

  3. 03

    Implement

    Build in small, reviewable increments, with approval gates on changes that carry risk.

    OutputWorking increments, each with its documentation.

  4. 04

    Validate

    Test the result against the agreed requirements and record what was checked, and what was not.

    OutputValidation notes and a handover record.

About

About ClearGlass Inc.

ClearGlass Inc. designs and builds software, automation and security-focused systems. The work rests on one idea: a system should be clear enough that the people responsible for it can see what it does, approve what matters, and check what happened.

Engagements are scoped to the problem at hand and documented as they go, so decisions, trade-offs and limits are on record rather than implied.

Based inOntario, Canada

Working principles

  • Show the work

    Decisions and trade-offs are written down.

  • Approve what matters

    People sign off on changes that carry risk.

  • State the limits

    What was not checked is reported with what was.
